title: Everyone writes an entry
text: A topic goes up. Write the best entry you can think of.

scene.tv: The best thing to bring to a desert island

title: Bet on a champion
text: Entries are seeded into a knockout bracket. Before the first match, bet on which entry will win it all.

title: Match by match
text: Each match, everyone except the two authors votes. Winners move on.

title: Scoring
text: Points for every vote your entry gets, a big bonus if it's champion, and more if you bet on the champion.
